### China Treats AI as Comprehensive Strategy and That Makes a Big Difference [...] Two things are certain to happen. The use of AI technology will continue to increase in the future. But so will technological innovation that delivers energy efficiency. The difficulty is to evaluate how quickly one will compensate for the other. [...] One estimate, published recently in an academic paper00365-3), is that by 2027, AI servers could consume similar levels of electricity as Argentina consumes in a year. This is equivalent to about 0.5% of the world's electricity use. If Google switched its entire search business to AI, this paper argues, it would almost double its energy consumption, equivalent to what Ireland consumes in a year.
